alt.tr: Salonda gri boyalı çıtalı kapaklı gömme dolaplar, camlı çift kanatlı kapı, tavan silmesi ve koyu renk parke zemin
alt.en: Grey painted built-in cabinets with raised panel doors, a glazed double door, ceiling cornice and dark wood floor

caption.tr: Duvar boyunca uzanan, çıta detaylı kapaklara sahip gömme dolaplar. Boyalı yüzeyler tavan silmesi ve duvar rengiyle uyumlu.
caption.en: Built-in cabinets running along the wall with moulded panel doors. The painted finish matches the ceiling cornice and wall color.
